semantics.initialization: none required; outputs depend continuously on current input
semantics.latency: zero clock cycles; combinational settling only
semantics.out_both: out_both[i] = in[i] AND in[i+1] for i=0..98; out_both[99]=0
semantics.out_any: out_any[i] = in[i] OR in[i-1] for i=1..99; out_any[0]=0
semantics.out_different: out_different[i] = in[i] XOR in[i+1] for i=0..98; out_different[99]=in[99] XOR in[0]

numeric.arithmetic: no arithmetic, signed interpretation, rounding, saturation, truncation or overflow

verification.oracle: independent per-bit loop from equations; compare all three output vectors after input settles
verification.directed: all zero, all one, alternating patterns; one-hot and one-cold at every position
verification.local_exhaustive: all four binary values of each adjacent pair, including wrapped pair, with other bits zero
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12, explicit dev_tb top, -g2012; finite compile and simulation timeouts
verification.acceptance: zero mismatches and explicit PASS; no official evaluation claims
